title: Data2Agent assessment rule
description: One canonical rule in an assessment profile. This record is the single source from which every projection is generated — prose for a skill, a structured listing, an executable check, a JSON Schema fragment, SHACL shapes. Six independently written rule sets would confound the form of a constraint with its content; one rule with six projections does not.

id.description: Stable across versions. Every projection and every assessment refers to the rule by this id.

principle.description: The FAIR principle this rule tests, e.g. F1, A1.1, R1.3.

question.description: The rule in one plain question. This text is what the prose projection presents to a model.

type.description: Names a deterministic implementation. An unimplemented type must be paired with implemented: false.

inputs.description: Manifest fields and evidence the check reads. A check may never open the dataset directly.

allowed_results.description: Must include 'unknown'. A rule that cannot report uncertainty will manufacture certainty instead.

inference_allowed.description: False by default. Setting it true requires a written justification in 'notes'.

evidence_required.description: Every result must say what was looked at — 'unknown' and 'not_applicable' included.

rationale_required_for.description: Outcomes that must carry a written explanation.

implemented.description: False keeps the rule in the registry, always returning 'unknown'. A dropped rule leaves the denominator; an unknown one stays countable.

not_implemented_reason.description: Required when implemented is false. Becomes the rationale of every 'unknown' the rule returns.
